verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of exposing HNSW graph parameters (ef, M), index type selection, or other tunable settings for trading recall against latency/memory — Pinecone's serverless architecture is described only in terms of namespaces, hybrid search, and multitenancy, with no mention of manual index-tuning controls. One community comment (pinecone-comm-8) notes Pinecone historically 'had HNSW' compared to pgvector, but this is about feature presence, not user-configurable tuning knobs.
